notes: Rule 425 press release filed by Barings BDC (BDC) announcing Sierra Income Corporation (non-traded BDC) merging into Barings BDC. Consideration is cash and stock: 0.44973 BBDC shares per Sierra share plus $100 million cash paid by Barings LLC (the adviser, not the acquirer), stated as approximately $0.98 per share. n_targets is not stated as a number; the filing names one target (Sierra). No collar, outside date, meeting date or record date stated. Barings LLC also provides a $100.0 million credit support agreement and Barings BDC up to $30.0 million in secondary-market share repurchases.
